title: Seattle Shield, an intelligence-sharing network operated by the Seattle police
summary: This investigative report reveals Seattle Shield, a police-operated intelligence-sharing network that partners with private companies to conduct surveillance, raising concerns about privacy, accountability, and the expansion of surveillance infrastructure in urban areas.
problem_solved: Police departments face challenges coordinating surveillance data across multiple private and public entities, and Seattle Shield addresses this by creating a centralized intelligence-sharing network.
why_valuable: It exposes the growing partnership between law enforcement and private surveillance companies, informing public debate about civil liberties and government surveillance practices.
